project.name: osgi/foundation/worktree
project.description: The worktree the seed cultivates, as ONE dual-realm component: it locates its own root (jgit walks up to the .git from any starting dir) and opens the repository rooted there — the single findGitDir door both realms rest on. The host reads it before Felix boots (Main derives worktree.dir; the entry gate checks the tree is clean); the incus scion reads it in-container (the reconstructed worktree's HEAD provenance). type=library dual-realm like incus-contract-host: staged as a bundle OSGi-side AND kept flat host-side. jgit is legitimate here — it carries a BSN, so it is a shared bundle OSGi-side and on the flat classpath host-side (present in BOTH realms, in the REALM_BOUNDARY intersection). No jgit type ever crosses the broker seam: Worktree/Repository are consumed locally in each realm, never placed in a SeedEnvelope (the seam is String-only), so no realm leak is possible.
